Source: Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/imperialjustice.gif in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). the file is still in the repository but no card uses it since 26 March 2021. Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged. [[Category:Virtual card images]]
